name: GetSiteById
description: Retrieves a single SharePoint site using its Site ID via Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Outlook Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and access SharePoint sites through Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: SiteId
fields.label: Site ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the SharePoint site to retrieve.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the details of the retrieved site including its ID, display name, URL, and other metadata.
